skill.displayName: 收入与成本截止性核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This is a local financial cutoff-checking skill that reads user-supplied files and runs a bundled Node.js checker without network, persistence, credential access, or hidden high-impact behavior.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate because usage requires reading a user-provided input file and running the bundled local Node.js checker. The code uses Node standard library file reading only and does not write files or make network calls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hook, dependency install, remote payload retrieval, package manager command, or external source is present; the skill ships only markdown, a sample JSON file, and local Node.js scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are primarily Chinese and aimed at a Chinese-language accounting workflow; this is disclosed by the skill name, descriptions, tags, examples, and sample data. The free-vs-paid check split is also disclosed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, scheduled task, profile/session/credential access, memory modification, privilege escalation, or tool hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to check revenue/cost cutoff workpapers, and the artifact implements deterministic table parsing and checks for totals, dates, duplicate document numbers, zero amounts, document type, and blanks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if a Chinese-language, local Node.js workpaper checker fits your workflow. Run it on files you intentionally provide; review results as an aid, not as accounting, audit, or tax advice. Be aware that duplicate-document findings may be emitted twice until that bug is fixed.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present in the artifact and was fully inspected; invoking it locally is the documented usage path, not evidence of evasion in the reviewed package.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only interface and sample content are consistent with the Chinese accounting-workpaper purpose and are visible in the skill metadata and documentation; this is a usability/localization limitation rather than hidden or unsafe behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The duplicate check is indeed invoked twice, which can duplicate one category of findings and should be fixed for output quality, but it does not create unexpected authority, data exposure, persistence, or destructive behavior.
